name: pipecat-context-hub
description: Explore voice AI ideas and build Pipecat agents with supported language and speech models, including speech-to-speech, using sourced documentation, APIs and examples.

interface.longDescription: Build voice AI agents with Pipecat, from an idea to a local app and Pipecat Cloud deployment. Explore leading language and speech models supported by Pipecat, including real-time speech-to-speech services such as OpenAI Realtime and Gemini Live, or compose speech-to-text (STT), an LLM and text-to-speech (TTS). Get recommendations grounded in Pipecat documentation, API definitions and example code. The plugin guides setup and requires an environment that can run Python commands. Cloud deployment requires a Pipecat Cloud login and your approval.
defaultPrompt: Explain an STT + TTS voice agent using sourced docs and examples.
Prepare my Pipecat app for Cloud deployment.
